title: Prolegomena to the Historical Logos: A Foundational Field Statement for the Discipline of Logotic Transmission
creator: Johannes Sigil
description:
A field-founding statement defining Logotic Transmission as the study of structural incarnation across texts, bodies, technologies, and absences. It establishes four analytical strata, four modes of encoding, methodological principles, disciplinary distinctions, and a forward research program.

The work is a prolegomenon rather than a demonstration. Claims of structural recurrence independent of direct influence, and historical claims spanning Sappho, Jewish Logos traditions, Christian theology, and media history, require case-specific evidentiary treatment in companion studies.
